commands:
cat > .git/hooks/pre-commit << 'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
# Pre-commit hook to run mypy type checking on Python files in src/

echo "Running mypy type checking on src/..."

# Find all Python files in src/ and run mypy
mypy src/

# Capture the exit code
MYPY_EXIT_CODE=$?

# If mypy found errors, block the commit
if [ $MYPY_EXIT_CODE -ne 0 ]; then
    echo ""
    echo "❌ Type-checking failed. Please fix the errors above before committing."
    exit 1
fi

echo "✅ Type-checking passed."
exit 0
EOF

cat > .git/hooks/pre-commit << 'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
# Pre-commit hook to run mypy type checking on staged Python files

echo "Running mypy type checking on staged files..."

# Get list of staged Python files
STAGED_FILES=$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM | grep -E '\.py$')

# If no Python files are staged, exit successfully
if [ -z "$STAGED_FILES" ]; then
    echo "ℹ️  No Python files staged. Skipping mypy check."
    exit 0
fi

# Run mypy on the staged Python files
echo "Checking files:"
echo "$STAGED_FILES"
mypy $STAGED_FILES

# Capture the exit code
MYPY_EXIT_CODE=$?

# If mypy found errors, block the commit
if [ $MYPY_EXIT_CODE -ne 0 ]; then
    echo ""
    echo "❌ Type-checking failed. Please fix the errors above before committing."
    exit 1
fi

echo "✅ Type-checking passed."
exit 0
EOF
